{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders with revenue 999999.99: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Filter out refunded orders
filtered_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Recompute 'converted' based on status: 1 if completed, 0 otherwise
filtered_df['converted'] = (filtered_df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Verify that all completed orders have converted == 1
assert filtered_df['converted'].sum() == len(filtered_df), "Not all completed orders have converted == 1"

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_percent = conversion_rate * 100
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate_percent:.2f}%')"}
